Name: Madrid Atocha station
Address: Plaza del Emperador Carlos V, 28045 Madrid
Tips: 19:44 arrival off AVE 4U5NZV (Coche 7, seats 2C/2D/3C/3D). Follow Salida signs, the taxi rank is signposted from the main concourse. If there are 10 spare minutes, the station's hidden sight is on the way out: the 4,000 sq m tropical garden in the 1851 Moneo hall - palms, ferns, a turtle pond, free, inside the station. Metro alternative: L1 from Estación del Arte 2 stops to Pacífico, L6 3 stops to Legazpi. Buy the Multi card now - 7.30 EUR/10 trips + 2.50 EUR card.

Name: Rocambolesc (Atocha)
Tips: Jordi Roca's soft-serve stand, inside the station. A welcome-to-Madrid ice cream at 19:50 if anyone needs one. No judgment.

Name: Plenora Alejandro Dumas
Address: C. de Alejandro Dumas 30, Arganzuela, Madrid 28005
Tips: 20:20 check in. DOOR PIN 7526. ONLINE CHECK-IN ALREADY COMPLETED - no paperwork at the door, the code is the whole procedure. Check-in opened 15:00 so the apartment is ready; if anything is off, the property phone is +34 661 781 481.

Name: El Brillante
Address: Plaza del Emperador Carlos V 8, 28012 Madrid
Tips: 21:00 - 10 min walk, and the exactly-right arrival meal. Bocadillo de calamares (3.50-7 EUR) + caña, Madrid's signature sandwich at the 1952 institution. Open daily to ~23:30, NO AUGUST CLOSURE. 21:00 is when Madrid starts eating - walking in without a booking is normal tonight.

Name: Bodegas Rosell
Tips: 21:00 option, 10 min - barrel-aged wine bar since 1920, vermut on tap, blue tiles. CLOSES ALL OF AUGUST and Sep 1 should be reopening day - CALL +34 914 678 458 BEFORE WALKING OVER.

Name: Carambola
Tips: 21:00 option, 15 min - family-friendly tapas, kids' menu, relaxed.

Name: Mercado de San Fernando
Tips: 21:00 option, 15 min - working-market food stalls in Lavapiés. Quick, casual, local.

Name: Madrid Río
Tips: 22:00 optional, 20-30 min, flat - the river park is 5 MIN FROM THE DOOR. Lit paths, cool air off the Manzanares, the baroque Puente de Toledo glowing to the north, and the giant tobogán slides near Matadero for burning off train energy. Then sleep - tomorrow is Royal Madrid.
